title: Commander portraits (12 commanders, 10 AI leaders, the ruler — 150 PNGs) and straight chests and crates (docs/art_direction.md §7)
common:
Project: /home/user/Raivon — «Raivon: Territory Wars», portrait mobile hex strategy in Godot 4.5.1 (Mobile renderer); all 3D art is procedural bpy in tools/blender/ (Blender bpy 5.0.1 is installed as a Python module: the scripts run with plain python3, see their docstrings).
Owner, verbatim (2026-10-11): «Командиры у тебя выглядят очень сыро. Ящики тоже какие то косые.» — brief п.37 (docs/00_brief.md): commander portraits (and the same kit for the AI leaders and the ruler) must reach the level of a released cartoon mobile game — expressive faces, a recognisable silhouette for each, the details from docs/gdd/04_units_army.md §15.3, uniforms by era; case chests and resource crates must be straight, symmetric, readable small, with no crooked perspective. Earlier direction: п.35–36 (soft friendly cartoon in the spirit of Clash of Clans — techniques only, never copied).
THE SPEC IS docs/art_direction.md §7 «Портреты командиров и сундуки» (Russian). Read the whole of §7 before anything else: every number there is the contract (face numbers §7.3, colour/plate rules §7.4, construction §7.5, the 12 commander sheets §7.6, eras §7.7, leaders §7.8, moods §7.9, ruler §7.10, camera/light/render §7.11, files and game §7.12, chests §7.13, checks and screenshot commands §7.14). §6 «Raivon Soft» still applies (albedo floor #2A2A30, glow only for VFX, §6.15 do-not-copy). UI system: docs/ui_style.md. Where §7 and GDD 04 §15.4 differ, §7 wins.
Inputs from the research phase (scratch, read-only; if any are missing, build from §7 — it holds all the numbers):
- /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/spike/bram_bust.py — the proven bust techniques (cage head + brushes, shader eyes, ray-cast curves, sheet-solved metaballs, ribbon locks, beard, boolean mouth, torso loft, jerkin shell, light rig); downscale.py (premultiplied Lanczos), calib_sheet.py; final/*.png (the spike renders; their eyes are still too small and the beard melts into the jerkin — §7 fixes both).

Rules:
- Other agents are editing game/scripts/game_ui.gd, hud.gd, ui_kit.gd, shop_ui.gd, main.gd and map_view.gd right now. Portrait and chest steps must NOT edit those files (reading them is fine). Edit only your step's owner_files; re-read a file right before editing it; never revert changes you did not make. If a fix needs one of the forbidden files, do not make it: report it as a follow-up with file, function and the exact change.
- NEVER run git commit/add/push/checkout/stash/reset (diff/status/log are fine). The main session commits.
- Godot: G=/opt/godot/Godot_v4.5.1-stable_linux.x86_64. Every Godot run takes the shared lock: import with `flock -w 1800 /tmp/raivon_godot.lock $G --headless --path game --import` (the same lock tools/godot_shot.sh takes); run tests and --check-only the same way when another workflow might be importing. Never start Godot outside the lock.
- Blender renders do not need the Godot lock, but the machine has 4 cores shared with other workflows: one render process at a time per step (Cycles already uses every thread), `nice -n 5`; long batches run in the background (Bash run_in_background, up to 2 h) and you poll the output folder; iterate at 24 samples / 256 px, final review renders at 64 samples (96 for hero sheets) / 512×588. Render scripts must be resume-safe (skip files that exist unless --force).
- Screenshots: `tools/godot_shot.sh OUT.png --lang=ru --shot-delay=3 [...]` — the portrait and chest demo list is in §7.14 (e.g. --demo=commanders:album:2, --demo=commanders:card, --demo=ultimatum, --demo=dip2 --shot-delay=12, --demo=shop, --demo=royal, --demo=calendar, --demo=pass). Read every PNG you make (they are images) and judge honestly against §7 and against the owner's bar: a polished released cartoon mobile game. «Better than before» is not the bar.
- Tests: `$G --headless --path game --script res://tests/test_flow.gd` — count the PASS lines before your change and keep the same count with no 'SCRIPT ERROR'; when portraits, icons or cmd_portrait.gd change also run res://tests/test_commanders.gd (era mapping), test_cases.gd, test_calendar.gd, test_pass.gd. `python3 tools/ui_lint.py --strict` and `python3 tools/check_strings.py` stay clean. GDScript syntax: `$G --headless --path game --check-only --script res://scripts/<file>.gd`.
- QA scripts (numpy + Pillow, run with `python3 -I`): tools/qa_portraits/ (created in P1) and tools/qa_icons/ (created in C1). Put their numbers in "measurements" (before → after). A gate you cannot meet is reported with the number and the reason, never silently relaxed; if a §7 threshold proves wrong, say so and propose the corrected number.
- Owner-facing sheets: every portrait step writes a contact sheet — the 512 renders; 128 and 64 px on the rarity plates (plate B, §7.4; both rarity palettes: ui_kit Kit.RARITY and GDD §15.4); 48 px black silhouettes; the game crops (tools/qa_portraits/sheet_uses.py) — and lists the paths in "screenshots".
- Scratch: everything temporary (renders, sheets, logs, before/after shots) goes under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/impl/<step id>/. Nothing temporary in the repo.
- Determinism: random only through random.Random(hash(id)), Cycles seed 0; a re-render matches (mean |diff| ≤ 0.5/255).
- Files: the 150 names, sizes and import rules of §7.12 are fixed (commanders 512×588, leaders and ruler 256×294, RGBA, transparent, no plate or frame baked; aspect 0.8707).
- Ours, not Supercell (§6.15): no assets, no eyedropped colours, no crowns or gems as symbols on chests; our symbols are the hex, the white eagle and raivite. The world is fictional: no real-world protected symbols (no red cross on Lira, no ermine on the ruler's fur, no real doge's corno on Velian).
- Reviewers: re-run the QA scripts and the kit checks yourself, open the sheets and the in-game shots, and compare with the owner screenshots in owner37/. A portrait that still reads as a «pawn» (ball head on a jar, bead eyes, floating parts, melting into the plate) is a high issue even if the scripts pass.
ART DIRECTOR NOTES (main session, after the P1 fix sheet, 2026-10-11 19:40) — apply in every later step and fix round: (1) Bram's skin still reads orange next to his ginger beard and hair: skin must be clearly lighter and pinker than any ginger hair (beard vs skin ΔL* ≥ 12 measured at the boundary, skin hue toward peach-pink, check under the AgX look actually used); the same for every ginger/brown-haired character. (2) Vega's pointer still reads as an arrow stuck through her side: either a visible sleeve and hand hold it, or tuck it under the arm with the arm silhouette visible, or drop it for a hand-free signature (the raised brow and glasses carry her). No prop may enter the body without a visible holder. (3) Beards and hair: fewer, larger, smoother clumps with clear strand-group shapes — no lumpy 'cauliflower' surface. (4) Judge every portrait at the album size (≈240 px) and at 64 px next to the current shipped set: it must read as a finished, lovable cartoon hero card, not a 3D experiment.
DECIDED after P1 (main session): §7.4 lit cheek is now L* from min(70, skin albedo L* − 8) to 82, and the HSV S floor is 0.27 for peach-pink skin (hue ≤ 16°) — keep Bram's P1-r3 peach-pink skin; update tools/qa_portraits accordingly. Vega carries no pointer (her brow and glasses are the signature).
ART DIRECTOR NOTES on the P2 work-in-progress sheet (it/r5, 2026-10-12 00:35) — reviewers check these, fixers fix them: (a) Olm's wrench floats in front of the apron with no holder — put it in the apron pocket (only the jaws and part of the handle showing) or in a visible hand. (b) Frey reads as wearing a dark beanie: her flat-top (ёжик) must read as HAIR (lighter than the uniform, visible bristle edge, skin of the forehead and temples below it, §7.6 bare-headed); her striped green tunic reads like a radiator — fewer, softer vertical seams. (c) Irma's gloved hand at the chin reads as a claw at the throat — drop the hand (gauntlets at the belt) unless it reads cleanly as a hand pulling on a glove; her platinum high ponytail reads as two white rabbit ears — one clear tail with a hair tie, falling behind. (d) Vance's hand holding the queen is a blob — either a readable hand (fingers, thumb, cuff) or the queen as a brooch/pendant on the jabot. (e) Hawk's white scarf sticks out sideways like a sausage — a scarf end that flutters back over the shoulder, thinner, with a fold; his ear flaps must read as a leather flying cap. (f) Every commander: the head must not look pasted on — neck, collar and shoulders join it; and the 12 must still differ in skin tones and silhouettes as they do now.

steps.title: Portrait kit v2: head, face, hair, beard, framing, sidecars and QA tools — proven on Bram, Lira and Vega (era 1, calm + smile)
owner_files: tools/blender/portrait_assets.py (entry point: cmd_bram, cmd_lira, cmd_vega go through the new kit; every other id keeps the old builder until P2/P3; the CLI stays)
steps.instructions:
Goal: the foundation every later portrait step builds on, judged on three very different faces: Bram (beard, potato nose, scar), Lira (braid, kerchief, freckles, female cues), Vega (bob with streak, see-through glasses, raised brow).
0. Read §7 (all of it; for this step especially §7.2–7.5, the Bram/Lira/Vega rows of §7.6, §7.11, §7.12, §7.14), /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/spike/bram_bust.py with its final renders, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/audit/audit.md, and the owner screenshots. Baseline: copy the current cmd_bram, cmd_lira, cmd_vega (+ _smile) from game/assets/ui/portraits to /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/impl/P1_face_kit/before/.
1. QA tools — tools/qa_portraits/:
   - from /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/design_A/qa/: qa_common.py, qa_silhouette.py, qa_framing.py, qa_contrast.py, qa_moods.py, qa_sheets.py; from /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/design_B/qa/: portrait_qa.py; from /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/audit/tools/sheet.py: sheet_uses.py (the 17 uses of §7.12 at real size with the game's crops, frames and plates).
   - Update them to §7: sizes (cmd_* 512×588, ldr_* and ruler* 256×294 — scale by the file's own size); framing fractions (top ≥ 0.051 h; ruler crown and leader headgear ≥ 0.085 h; nothing within 0.055 w of the sides above 0.70 h; eye line 0.425 h ± 0.01; head x 0.50 w ± 0.025); contrast against **plate B** (rc.lightened(0.18) → rc, §7.4) as the gated mode and today's plate as INFO; both rarity palettes (Kit.RARITY from game/scripts/ui_kit.gd and GDD §15.4); leader plates = the colours the game actually passes to CmdPortrait.plate (find where leader info "color" comes from in main.gd / game_ui.gd — read-only — and use exactly those; Barons = war red #DD3A30); the ruler on SKY #8FCDF2.
   - They must run on a folder that holds only some of the 150 names (report the missing ones, gate what exists), with a usage docstring each, numpy + Pillow only, under python3 -I.
   - Run them on game/assets/ui/portraits and record the baseline (it should roughly reproduce the «Сейчас» column of §7.14).
2. Kit — tools/blender/portrait_kit/ per §7.5 (style, core, head, face, hair, beard, body, garments, headgear, props, rig, chars, qa; garments/headgear/props may start with only what these three need). Port the spike's proven techniques; keep its lessons (import bpy before bmesh; unique metaball names; cast each ray straight at its target; positive shift_x moves the content left; mood-dependent beard line; drop Subsurf on metaball meshes, Smooth 2–3 instead). Characters are data in chars.py; features are placed from head landmarks and ray casts, never from fixed coordinates. Implement the §7.3 numbers through one STYLE table (style.py).
3. Build the three era-1 looks exactly as their §7.6 rows (face table, signature, calm → smile, props, palette, Э1 column). Bram: pear beard 0.12 W wider than the jaw each side and 0.45 H below the chin, #C8652F lighter than the hair, potato nose, bushy 0.085 H brows, stitched scar, linen shirt + slate felt jerkin #3F4D5E + belt with brass buckle, spoon behind the buckle, millstone amulet, 2 chevrons. Lira: oval, painted freckles, braid of 6 plaited lobes over the near shoulder with a green ribbon, kerchief shell over the hair (no torn hairline) with two knot tails, green jacket #2E7A44 + white apron bib, satchel strap with the leaf badge and bandage roll. Vega: heart face, asymmetric bob with the chisel point and one silver streak lock, rectangular rounded glasses with see-through glass lenses (irises keep ≥ 70 % of their contrast), far brow permanently +0.09 H, graphite coat with silver frogging; her arrow-pointer may use the tucked-under-the-arm pose until P2's hand module.
4. Rig (§7.11): 85 mm, sensor_fit VERTICAL, level camera at eye height, framing solver by shift and distance (eye y 250 ± 2, head x 256 ± 12, H_px per character ± 3; skyline ≥ 30 px; side band; H_px steps down by 4 to 256, else fail with a message), per-character pose and the gaze solver, the key / rim / kicker / world rig, AgX Punchy, Cycles 64 samples (96 for the review set), adaptive 0.01, OIDN, filter 1.2, seed 0, persistent data, transparent 512×588 RGBA; premultiplied Lanczos downscale helper.
5. Kit QA: --sidecars=DIR writes meta/<name>.json (projected landmarks in PNG px: eye_y, chin_y, crown_y, skyline_y, head_box, sig_box, h_px, iris centres, eye openings, brow end points, mouth corners; the floating list) and ids/<name>.png (flat-emission part-ID pass, box filter, 1 sample, Standard view; the groups portrait_qa.py expects plus signature and detail:<name>); --contacts (BVH contact test of §7.14 P-A7); --stats (triangles, build and render seconds). Wire tools/qa_portraits/portrait_qa.py to read them.
6. portrait_assets.py: CLI unchanged (`OUTDIR ids... [--size] [--eras] [--moods]`) + --samples, --frame=bust|face, --sidecars, --contacts, --stats, --force; the three proof ids go through the new kit; the module docstring's three regeneration commands stay valid.
7. Render the three × calm, smile at 512×588 into /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/impl/P1_face_kit/ (sidecars on), downscale to 256 / 128 / 64, and build the owner sheet: 512; 128 and 64 on rarity plates (Bram, Lira common; Vega rare) with plate B and both palettes; 48 px silhouettes; the game crops via sheet_uses.py; side by side with the current kit and the spike.
8. Iterate until all three pass: P-A3 readability at 128 and 64 (brows, eye opening, iris, pupil, catchlight, mouths), P-A5 contrast (plate B, both palettes; lit cheek L* 70–82, skin S ≥ 0.35; hair, brows, beard, iris rules), P-A6 framing (for these files), P-A7 contacts (nothing floats or is buried), P-A10 determinism (render one id twice) and budget (≤ 500 k tris, ≤ 70 s at 64 samples), calm vs smile visible at 64 px (qa_moods on the pair: ≥ 4 % at 138 px and ≥ 3.5 % at 80 px), and the six finish criteria of §7.2 by eye at 512. The eyes must be cartoon-big (sclera 0.18–0.21 H, two catchlights): the spike's are too small.
steps.verify:
- Before/after sheet: current kit vs spike vs P1 for Bram, Lira, Vega, calm and smile, at 512, 128, 64 and as 48 px silhouettes, on the rarity plates (plate B and today's plate, both palettes) and in the game crops (album tile, card, calendar 64, army chip 48, seal size).
- QA numbers for the three ids: P-A3 (per-feature px at 128 and 64), P-A5 (shoulder band ΔL* vs each plate, rim share, hair/brow/beard ΔL*, lit-skin L* and S), P-A6 (eye y, head x, skyline, sides), P-A7 (contact report empty), P-A10 (re-render diff, triangles, seconds per frame), qa_moods calm vs smile.
- Baseline of all tools/qa_portraits scripts on the current game set (commands and output), proving the tools run.
- The kit CLI: the docstring commands, a run with --sidecars --contacts --stats, and proof that other ids still render through the old builder.
- Nothing under game/ changed (git status).

steps.title: All 12 commanders, era 1, calm + smile: faces, bodies, costumes, props, creatures, hands
steps.instructions:
Goal: the twelve commanders as finished hero cards in era 1, each recognisable by silhouette, with the §15.3 details visible.
0. Read the P1 result (resume key P1_impl, or the kit and its sheet in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/impl/P1_face_kit/), §7.2 (signature zones, tiers, finish criteria), §7.3 (body and costume rules), §7.5 (hands, glasses), all twelve rows of the three §7.6 tables, §7.14.
1. Costume system (garments.py): shells from the torso rings (tunic, jerkin, coat with lapels, greatcoat, jacket, apron, gambeson, robe, cape and cloak, hood), layers 0.012 H apart, thickness ≥ 0.02 H, bevels; real collars (stand, roll, fur sheet, cape collar, lace jabot, sheepskin); closures and insignia ray-cast along the normal; epaulettes and pauldrons cast onto the flat shoulder tops; straps shrinkwrapped with their ends tucked under something; fur as a metaball sheet with clumps, never a torus. No flat white collar triangle.
2. Headgear (headgear.py): hats seated on the hair's hat ring (24 rim samples, rim 0.01 H into the hair), brims ≥ 0.04 H, visors down 14°, locks inside the hat culled and 6–10 escape locks grown below the rim — hair stays visible under every hat. Era-1 needs: Lira's kerchief, Vik's hood with the peak, Seir's plain tricorn, Hawk's leather cap with flaps and goggles, Olm's brass goggles, Irma's driving goggles, Rai's circlet with the hex raivite (emission caps §7.4).
3. Props and creatures (props.py) per the «Реквизит» column: spoon, millstone, satchel + leaf badge + bandage roll, wrench, pencil, the raven (metaball body 0.55 H, ribbon-lock wing folds, tail fan, #343A52 with #5A6FA0 sheen, yellow eye with catchlight, claws ray-cast onto the near shoulder, ≥ 0.06 H clear of the cheek), bow tip and quiver strap, arrow-pointer, hourglass on a chain, spyglass, earring, tower badge, gauntlet, scarf ribbon, wings badge, sheepskin collar, chess queen, pearl brooch, staff-banner with our white eagle, Rai's cape collar and blue stole (the beard lies on the stole).
4. Hands (§7.5) for Vance, Seir, Irma, Vega: build the hand pose AND the hand-free fallback for each; put both on the sheet; keep the hand only where it meets §7.5 (fingers ≥ 0.07 H, ≤ 15 % of the face box, never over the mouth, finish criteria at 512 and readable at 128); report which won for each (§7.15 q3: the P2 reviewer decides by the §7.3/§7.14 bar).
5. Build all 12 era-1 looks from §7.6 (face table, signature in its zone, calm → smile, pose, palette, Э1 column, the «чтобы не путать» list). chars.py: a signature registry (no two ids share one) and a lint that runs at build time.
6. All twelve commander ids go through the new kit for era 1 (eras 2–4 may still fall back to the old builder until P3). Render 24 files (12 × calm, smile) at 512×588, 64 samples, sidecars on, into /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/impl/P2_commanders_e1/; the final review sheet at 96.
7. QA and iterate until: P-A1 on the era-1 calm files (each commander pair head IoU ≤ 0.85, median ≤ 0.78); P-A2 blind naming — build the shuffled 48 px silhouette sheet, name the 12 from it WITHOUT looking at the key, then check: ≥ 11/12 (report honestly; a reviewer repeats it); P-A3; P-A5 against plate B on both palettes (Bram, Lira, Olm, Vik on common grey; Vega, Kort, Seir, Frey on rare; Irma, Hawk, Vance on epic purple; Rai on legendary orange); P-A6; P-A7; P-A8 (the era-1 GDD detail table, minimum visible px); P-A9 (mean ΔE76 of the 4 largest colour groups ≥ 15 between any two commanders; registry); P-A10. Calm vs smile must read at 64 px for each.
8. Owner sheet: all 12 calm + smile at 512; 128 and 64 on their rarity plates; the 48 px silhouettes; the game crops (album tile 242×312, card 312×352, calendar 64, picker 72, army fan 58×70, army chip Ø38, reveal 87×100) via sheet_uses.py; side by side with the current set (owner37/portraits.png).
steps.verify:
- Owner sheet paths (12 × calm/smile at 512, 128, 64 on plates; 48 px silhouettes; game crops; current vs new).
- QA table for the 24 files: P-A1 IoU matrix (max, median, pairs > 0.85), P-A2 blind naming score with the guesses, P-A3, P-A5 (per file and plate), P-A6, P-A7 (contact report), P-A8 (each GDD detail's visible px vs its minimum), P-A9 (ΔE matrix, registry lint), P-A10 (tris, seconds).
- The hand decision for Vance, Seir, Irma, Vega with both renders.
- Nothing under game/ changed.

steps.title: Eras 2–4 for the 12 commanders, the 10 AI leaders × 5 moods, the ruler × 4 eras
steps.instructions:
Goal: the rest of the 150 looks, rendered and checked in scratch (P4 writes them into the game).
0. Read the P2 result (resume key P2_impl, or /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/portraits/impl/P2_commanders_e1/), §7.6 («Палитра и эпохи» table), §7.7, §7.8, §7.9, §7.10, §7.14.
1. Eras (§7.7): the Э2, Э3, Э4 columns of §7.6 per commander; the era colour transform table (hue locked; E3 mix with #6E6A4E 0.20, E4 painted plates, glow strips ≤ 1.6 and ≥ 0.04 H wide); headgear unique within each era across commanders (the chars.py lint fails the build on a duplicate); E4 helmets open, visors raised, hair through or around every hat; the face, hair, facial hair, signature, accent colour and the prop's identity never change (the prop's material does: raven → raven with a message tube → clockwork raven → raven-drone standing on landing legs; Olm's wrench → spanner → pipe wrench → plasma cutter; Vance's queen wood → silver → porcelain → holo; Seir's spyglass → rangefinder; Bram keeps the wooden spoon in armour). Render 72 files (12 × e2/e3/e4 × calm/smile).
2. Leaders (§7.8): the ten from the table — rules 1–7 (no commander-locked module; signature from archetype + epithet; costume by value against the state plate, state colour as an accent ≥ 10 %; headgear and props at y ≥ 50 of the master; costume tier by chapter; true triangles allowed). Moods (§7.9) as deltas on each leader's own calm + the per-leader overrides in the table (Grodek's fangs, Mirosya's gold-tooth glint and monocle zoom, Iveta's glasses slid or glinting, Torvald's near-shut eyes, Velian's monocle hanging when tired, Bjorulf's feathers drooping −20°, Arman's brim over the eyes). Render 50 files at the 512 master, downscale to 256×294 (premultiplied Lanczos).
3. Ruler (§7.10): our crown — gold band 0.07 H with 5 rounded merlons, a blue hex raivite in each, a small white eagle on the centre one, the blue velvet cap visible between the merlons — in all 4 eras; groomed round brown beard; plain white fur without ermine tails; costumes Э1–Э4. Render 4 files, master → 256×294.
4. Run all three on the current icons for the baseline.
2. icon_assets.py (re-read first):
   - render(): a camera mode per icon — "object" (perspective 85 mm, 36 mm sensor, camera raised 25°, rotation_euler (65°, 0, 0), aimed at the bbox centre, distance solved for FILL 0.9 with shift_x and shift_y — port render_v2) for chest_wood, chest_silver, chest_royal, chest_cards, crate, gift; "emblem" (the current ortho camera) for everything else.
